geo3d-motion-stage — binary data attribution

BVH motion data: Perfume global site project #001
https://perfume-global.com/web/2012/03/perfume-global-site-project-001/
Input files: aachan.bvh, kashiyuka.bvh, nocchi.bvh

The ROMs contain converted motion from those files, credited to the official primary project above. The project provided BVH and MP3; only BVH motion is used here. The official MP3 is not used or distributed.
The official article describes an open-source project providing motion data
for fan-created derivatives. This demo follows that fan-creation purpose.
That description is not represented as a blanket license grant for BVH.

The character meshes, viewer, converter and original PSG music were created
for this project.

Original song, WAV, BIOS and emulator binaries are not included.
This is an independent, unofficial fan project, without endorsement.

tools/machines/MOTIONGT.xml and tools/machines/MOTIONCB.xml derive from
openMSX GPL-2.0 definitions. GPL-2.0 applies only to these two configuration
files, not the application code or BVH motion data.
See ../licenses/GPL-2.0.txt and ../THIRD_PARTY.md.
